title: US labor-based share of tax revenue
source_name: BEA National Income and Product Accounts, via FRED
notes: Formula: (W055RC1Q027SBEA personal current taxes + W782RC1Q027SBEA contributions for government social insurance) / (W054RC1Q027SBEA government current tax receipts + W782RC1Q027SBEA) x 100. All levels, all governments (federal, state, and local), seasonally adjusted annual rates. Quarters where any input is unpublished are omitted.
